CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 03 / 10

Consumer and producer surplus

Surplus areas剩餘面積

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify consumer surplus as the area below demand and above the buyer's price, and producer surplus as the area above supply and below the seller's price, over the units actually traded.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

CS 在需求線下、買方價格上；PS 在供給線上、賣方價格下，只計至實際交易量。有稅時兩邊使用不同價格。

CS lies below demand and above buyer price; PS lies above supply and below seller price. Integrate only over units actually traded. When tax creates two prices, use Pb for CS and Ps for PS.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Linear demand intercept 10, P=6, Q=4 gives CS=½×4×(10−6)=8. 以實際交易四單位作三角形底。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Demand intercept 12, P=8, traded Q=4. CS? 線性需求下 CS？
